title: Ziggurat with Bath House
content: I used to dream of this place a lot. It's a ziggurat, a rectangular stepped tower, with a beautiful bath house at the top. While it's beautiful in this place, the nature and architecture alike, the people there are BRUTAL. Socially inept and devoid of an essence that the rest of us share. Interacting with those soulless creatures screwed with my mind - how could a civilization be so advanced, yet, have no soul? How come my people from my planet have spirit and love in their hearts, but these folks don't? These dreams made me proud to be an Earthling (I know that sounds funny.) We have soul, character, our own independent identities, and love in our hearts. Whereas these creatures, who I used to believe were deities, have NOTHING going on inside of them. Like they barely even exist. The art there sucked, like it was printed on plain office paper and put in a gawdy frame and haphazardly hanged. There was absolutely no substance when it came to their fashion. They're so boring and predictable, I felt like I could have written their script for them. Socializing with them was painful and irritating. These dreams went on for a long time, and I got so sick of them, I didn't want to go to sleep because I didn't want to end up there. I haven't dreamt of this place in awhile, thank goodness. Persistent dream world is awesome, but so is our subconscious/unconscious mind. I think my mind was trying to tell me that my world isn't as bad as I make it out to be, people are actually awesome, Earth is as beautiful as it gets, and I also gained tons of respect for art. Earth Art > Ziggurat Art
